stages.title: Fundamentals of Motion
stages.material: Read the kinematics intro and learn to tell the vector quantities apart.
stages.check: Solve 10 problems, get 8 right, and show velocity/acceleration vectors on a graph.

stages.title: Uniform Motion
stages.material: Derive x = x₀ + vt and sketch motion graphs in different directions.
stages.check: Solve a catch-up problem at three difficulty levels.

stages.title: Uniform Acceleration
stages.material: Derive the core kinematics formulas and write one problem for each.
stages.check: Find the displacement from a v(t) graph (3 problems).

stages.title: Free Fall
stages.material: Solve problems with g = 9.8 m/s² and understand when to ignore air resistance.
stages.check: 5 problems on flight time and height of a thrown body.

stages.title: Curvilinear Motion
stages.material: Review the horizontal-throw and circular-motion formulas.
stages.check: Solve a horizontal-throw problem and derive the centripetal acceleration formula.

stages.title: Problem Drill
stages.material: Solve at least 30 kinematics problems (textbook + online banks).
stages.check: 10 random bank problems against the clock (score 70%+).

stages.title: UNT-format Practice
stages.material: Collect and analyze past UNT kinematics tasks.
stages.check: 20-question test: 16+ correct within the time limit.

stages.title: Final Mock Test
stages.material: Review every topic and solve hard combined problems.
stages.check: Final UNT-format test: 20+ of 25 correct — you are ready!
